title: The Dark Room of DCX — test selections from pages 112–136
selectionPolicy: One representative per distinct, non-duplicative, non-explicit visual detail. Complete explicit photographs and repeated visual families are not included in this public test patch.

items.description: Isolated non-explicit detail of a dark choker with a small circular metal pendant. This is an alternate accessory reference, not a replacement for DCX's permanent dark left-wrist bracelet.
Environment-only crop showing a warm red wall, mosaic tile and water reflections. It may inform a future aquatic-room setting, but is not yet assigned to FireIce, Blood Cherry or Grass Bass.

excluded: Other pages in 112–136 contain explicit/intimate framing, repeat sock/mesh/pose families already represented in the previous archive, or do not add a distinct suitable public reference.
